title: Two Gold Cups Had Problems
text:
Two Gold Cups Had Problems. Two separate Gold cups had to be returned due to paint job issues. The first cup's problem was on the outside of the cup, while the second cup's problem was on the inside of the cup. The inside issue was that the CARIVINO letters were not completely white.

After seeing the inside of the cup I have become skeptical that the interior is actually ceramic. Maybe it is ceramic coating sprayed over the stainless steel that is used, which could explain why I can see the darker color on some of the areas of the CARIVINO letters. If it's ceramic coating, that could also explain why the inside layer is so thin.

I have decided not to try for a third Gold cup.
